rules.statement: An amicable division can be given effect to by a deed of partition and a partition plan where all the co-owners sign agreeing to the division or by cross conveyances executed by each of the co-owners, whereby the notarial deeds would be the best evidence of the termination of the common ownership.
rules.supporting_quote: "An amicable division can be given effect to by a deed of partition and a partition plan where all the co‐owners sign agreeing to the division or by cross conveyances executed by each of the co‐owners, whereby the notarial deeds would be the best evidence of the termination of the common ownership."

meta.parties: Appuhamy v. Premalal and Eight Others
